I'm a data analyst with over ten years in business intelligence, financial reporting, and process improvement, now an AI research fellow with the Griffiss Institute at the Air Force Research Laboratory. I build SQL, dbt, and Python workflows that replace manual processes and reconcile data across systems, and I design evaluations for machine-learning and LLM systems. I'm completing an M.S. in Data Science and Analytics at SUNY Polytechnic Institute, expected May 2027.
:::

### Griffiss Institute / Air Force Research Laboratory

**AI Research Fellow** · May 2026–Present

- Built a reusable Python pipeline to acquire roughly 5,000 research papers from OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar, parse them, and extract structured evidence with LLMs, supporting literature-review automation and institutional trust research.
- Benchmarked Python PDF-parsing libraries against LLM-based extraction on accuracy, segmentation quality, hallucination rate, and cost; the results set the pipeline's defaults.
- Built reproducible ML and LLM evaluation workflows on SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL, with Qdrant for vector search, Pydantic schema validation, and resumable batch processing across multi-million-row experiment datasets.
- Configured a two-node NVIDIA DGX Spark cluster for on-premises edge AI inference, benchmarking tensor- and pipeline-parallel vLLM serving of open-weight LLMs across concurrency levels to identify the highest-throughput configurations.
- Set up a standardized development environment on DGX Spark hardware for incoming interns and contractors, automating the provisioning of Open WebUI, Tailscale, VS Code, and coding agents to mirror on-premises servers.
- Designed and analyzed experiments in Python and R, tracking configurations in MLflow and scoring clustering quality, stability, and agreement against reference categories.
- Applied natural language processing, embeddings, clustering, and network analysis to evaluate and refine a computational taxonomy of psychological influence and propaganda techniques affecting institutional trust.
- Developed an agentic-development methodology for the team, defining project intake, agent roles, workflow decision trees, LLM skill files, and quality gates.

## Skills

**Languages:** SQL, Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PySpark, scikit-learn, Pydantic), R (tidyverse), Bash.

**Statistics and machine learning:** regression, ANOVA, factorial experimental design, sampling design, statistical inference, classification, clustering and community detection; PyTorch, sentence-transformers, HDBSCAN, UMAP, NetworkX.

**LLM and retrieval systems:** Ollama, vLLM, LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB, Qdrant, BM25 and hybrid retrieval, LLM-based extraction and scoring, prompt versioning, evaluation-harness design.

**Data and analytics engineering:** dbt, Snowflake, Databricks (Lakeflow, Asset Bundles), PostgreSQL, DuckDB, SQLite, MLflow, Hightouch, JSON Schema and Pydantic validation, PDF parsing (PyMuPDF, pdfplumber).

**Business intelligence and visualization:** Power BI, Tableau, TIBCO Spotfire, Grafana, Streamlit, LookML, Excel and macros, matplotlib, seaborn, Quarto.

**Infrastructure and cloud:** Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Document AI, RAG Engine, Compute Engine GPU instances), Azure Database for PostgreSQL and Managed Grafana, NVIDIA CUDA, multi-node vLLM serving on DGX Spark, Docker Compose, Proxmox VE, Prometheus, Tailscale, Ubuntu Linux.

**Engineering practice:** Git, GitHub Actions, pytest, MLflow experiment tracking, versioned prompts and configurations, idempotent batch pipelines, Claude Code and agent-assisted development.

**Enterprise systems:** SAP, Flex PLM, Salesforce, SharePoint, OpenText Invoice Management, Shopify, HubSpot, EDI and POS systems.
